description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This leadership role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to a compassionate environment focused on delivering exceptional patient care and fostering a supportive team culture.As an ADON, you will play a crucial role in assisting the Director of Nursing with the overall management of the nursing department. Your responsibilities will include supervising nursing staff, ensuring adherence to quality care standards, and maintaining compliance with all regulatory requirements. You will be instrumental in promoting a positive and efficient work environment.This full-time position offers a competitive salary range of $60,000 to $75,000 per year. We are particularly interested in candidates who are Registered Nurses (RNs) and possess a strong commitment to clinical excellence and leadership within a skilled nursing setting.
requirements: Minimum of 2-3 years of nursing experience, with at least 1 year in a supervisory or leadership role
Experience within a skilled nursing facility or long-term care setting
Strong understanding of state and federal healthcare regulations
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $60,000 to $75,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications.
